0022600093.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Clippers host the Sacramento Kings, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Clippers a 65% chance to win. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), and Kobe Sanders (hip) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while the Kings are without Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The Clippers won their last regular-season meeting 138-109 in Sacramento on April 5 and took the 2025-26 season series 3-1.
